cdf_version: Internal CDF version tracking. Do not modify manually.
pmos_w: Width of the PMOS core devices.
pmos_l: Channel length of the PMOS core devices.
nmos_w: Width of the NMOS core devices.
nmos_l: Channel length of the NMOS core devices.
model_type: Select the device model variant (e.g., High Voltage 'HV' or Low Voltage 'LV').
horizontal_spacing: Distance between adjacent devices horizontally within the same row.
vertical_spacing: Distance vertically between adjacent device rows in the array.
connect_gates_use_poly: Enable to route gate connections using the Poly layer instead of the horizontal routing metal.
horizontal_connection_width: Width of the horizontal routing metal tracks.
vertical_connection_width: Width of the vertical routing metal tracks.
connection_spacing: Minimum spacing between adjacent routing metal tracks to satisfy DRC rules.
nmos_layout_pattern:
Format: rows separated by spaces. 
Prefix a letter with a number to repeat it (4A -> AAAA). Append *N to repeat the whole row N times. 
Example: 4A3B2C*3 AABBCC -> AAAABBBCC drawn 3 times, then AABBCC.
pmos_layout_pattern:
Format: rows separated by spaces. 
Prefix a letter with a number to repeat it (4A -> AAAA). Append *N to repeat the whole row N times. 
Example: 4A3B2C*3 AABBCC -> AAAABBBCC drawn 3 times, then AABBCC.
gate_connection_top_devices: Specify the device letters whose gates should be routed toward the top of the array row.
gate_connection_bot_devices: Specify the device letters whose gates should be routed toward the bottom of the array row.
gate_connected_to_source_devices: Specify the device letter(s) whose gate is internally tied to its own Source terminal.
gate_connected_to_drain_devices: Specify the device letter(s) whose gate is internally tied to its own Drain terminal.
gates_connected_devices:
Specify devices whose gates are connected together.

Group devices that share the same net into one block, separate different nets with a space.
Example: AB CD
source_connected_devices:
Specify devices whose Source terminals are connected together.

Group devices that share the same net into one block, separate different nets with a space.
Example: AB CD
drain_connected_devices:
Specify devices whose Drain terminals are connected together.

Group devices that share the same net into one block, separate different nets with a space.
Example: AB CD
drains_to_tap_devices: Specify the device letters whose Drain terminals should be tied directly to the well tap / guard ring.
sources_to_tap_devices: Specify the device letters whose Source terminals should be tied directly to the well tap / guard ring.
draw_vertical_connections: Check this box to automatically generate vertical routing structures.
draw_horizontal_connections: Check this box to automatically generate horizontal routing structures.
odd_vertical:
Check this box to route odd-numbered metals vertically and even-numbered metals horizontally.

Uncheck it for the inverse: odd-numbered metals horizontal and even-numbered metals vertical.
dummies_count: Number of dummy devices to place at the outer edges (left and right) of the row.
inner_dummies_count: Number of dummy devices to place internally between different core devices.
dummy_pmos_l: Channel length for the PMOS dummy devices.
dummy_nmos_l: Channel length for the NMOS dummy devices.
dummies_core_spacing: Spacing between the core array and the dummy devices. Use a negative value to force diffusion merging.
overlap_dummies_diffusions: Check this box to overlap the Source/Drain diffusions of dummy devices to save layout area.
place_taps: Enable to generate substrate or well taps internally between the devices in the row.
metal_level:
Specify the minimum (starting) metal layer used for routing.

Routing can only use this layer and above; lower metals are reserved and skipped.

Example:
If devices normally route with two levels — met1 horizontal and met2 vertical — setting this to 2 forces routing to start at met2 instead. The two-level pair then shifts up: met2 (vertical) and met3 (horizontal).

In short: raising this value shifts your whole routing stack up, leaving the lower metals untouched.
